Alex / Jasmine — thanks for the packet. I pulled the Zephyr MSA and did a quick scan. High-level items and next steps below. Attaching our Redline_guidance_checklist.pdf to help Zephyr map priority clauses.

Intake summary (initial):
- Template baseline: we'll start from Redwood Master Services Agreement v2026-std (internal template).
- Major flags observed in Zephyr_MSA_draft_v1.docx: data residency wording (Exhibit D missing region), 1-year auto-renew vs Evergreen clauses, and a broader indemnity carveout in Section 7.
- Order form: seat definitions aligned but pricing bands need explicit subscription terms (billing cadence + seat ramp).

Action items / timeline:
- By EOD 9/15: Kimberly to deliver a redline callout memo summarizing top-5 commercial/legal risks. (attached checklist included)
- By 9/21: Rishi to produce a first redline MSA (tracked changes) and an annotated order form with comments on pricing & SLAs.
- By 9/23: Internal review + canary share with Zephyr for Q&A.

Sender / signer mapping request for Zephyr (please fill):
1) MSA legal approver (name / title / email)
2) Commercial signatory for order form (name / title / email)
3) Billing contact (name / email / phone)

Alex — attaching the checklist and our small intake template. If Zephyr can return the signer matrix and confirm whether they require an alternate SLA exhibit (we offer a regional residency exhibit), we can confirm the Rishi timeline above.

Thanks,

Team / Alex — quick update after scanning the docs:

1) Timeline: I can produce an initial tracked redline (MSA + order form comments) by close of business 2026-09-21 as requested. That gives internal review time and a short Q&A window before Zephyr's 9/28 approval target.

2) Key asks for Zephyr (to avoid rework):
- Please confirm whether your requirement is strictly "US-only" for all logs and PII, or if a regional carveout is acceptable for non-PII telemetry. That determines whether we include our Regional Residency Exhibit or the standard residency clause.
- Ellen (cc): if you can share the latest SOC 2 Type II report or an encrypted copy/summary and the name of your security contact, we can annotate evidence references in Exhibit D. 

3) Signer flow: We recommend countersignature via DocuSign; once redlines are preliminarily agreed we will generate a single consolidated MSA + order form package and share a DocuSign envelope. If Zephyr prefers a two-step (MSA first, order form later) please confirm.

I'll start the redline and include a short comment set focused on residency, indemnity carveouts, and termination for convenience (we tend to preserve 60-day notice for commercial accounts).

Rishi Malhotra
